label: Straight Jetted Flap 5.0 cm
description: The straight jetted flap pocket sets its mouth dead level across the hip, parallel to the floor, and covers it with a flat rectangular flap lying flush against the jacket face. At 5.0 cm the flap is a middling depth that neither asserts itself nor disappears. Its lower edge runs parallel to the mouth above it across the full width, and the jets beneath are cut to the same length as the flap so nothing protrudes at either end. It is the standard lower pocket on business and city suits, reading as clean and authoritative.
